supporting_observations.claim: GradeBook Pro's updater ran from its installed program directory under raul.diaz's account shortly before the observed connections.
The updater made a proxy connection for update.gradebookpro.com at 13:38:08; the proxy returned 504, and host telemetry attributes the connection to the updater process.

Further updater connections to update.gradebookpro.com occurred at 13:42:38, 13:47:21, 13:52:52, 13:57:28, 14:02:36, and 14:07:26—roughly five-minute intervals—and the host records associate them with the same updater process.
The later updater checks received proxy status 200; the final observed check received 407, after which the updater process exited.
The observed host, executable, destination, and approximate cadence match the inventory description of the approved GradeBook Pro updater checking update.gradebookpro.com about every five minutes.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records document the updater checks beginning at 13:38:08; they do not establish what happened during the earlier part of the alert window.
The connections are logged from the workstation to the explicit proxy at port 8080. The records identify the requested hostname and process, but do not provide a full capture of all network content.
The evidence does not include a hash or signature-validation result for the updater executable.
claims_not_established: The records do not independently verify that the updater executable is authentic and unmodified.
The records do not establish whether any activity occurred outside the supplied telemetry or before the first observed updater connection.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: WS-RDIAZ-01's browser accessed aws.amazon.com and AWS static assets at about 14:05. The records show web browsing, not use of an AWS cloud-storage or remote-access service; this does not decide the alerted activity. Records: T276-00339, T276-00340, T276-00346, T276-00348, T276-00349, T276-00358, T276-00359, T276-00360.

Separate review: WS-RDIAZ-01 made SMB connections to DC-ORC-01 at 13:35, 13:43, and 14:09. These are not the alerted HTTPS connections, and the records alone do not establish their purpose. Records: T276-00156, T276-00160, T276-00219, T276-00223, T276-00412, T276-00416.

Separate review: the workstation machine account had Kerberos ticket events using certificate pre-authentication at 14:08 and 14:16. This is distinct from the updater connections; the supplied evidence does not establish whether it is expected. Records: T276-00387, T276-00427.
